title: The Perfect Portrait
author: Kestrel Sandoval
blurb: Oscar Crane, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
